title: Fossil Field — Dead Mechanics We Eat, Not Dead Currency

concept.what: Dead crypto projects aren't dead tokens. They're dead MECHANICS. The mechanics are fossils — preserved in bytecode, open source, on-chain. We eat the mechanics. We scatter from the cairns to find more.
concept.loopring_age: Died June 29, 2026. Barely 4 months. Still warm. Barely a fossil — more like fresh roadkill.
concept.principle: Currency dies. Mechanics fossilize. Genomes persist on-chain even when the game dies. The chain remembers.
concept.bingo_insight: CryptoKitties' 256-bit genome IS a bingo board. Each of 48 gene positions is a voxel axis. Breeding = voxel operation (combine two points in gene space ? produce a third). This is bingoCube territory, not finance.

fossils.name: CryptoKitties
fossils.status: zombie (Telegram idle game on Flow, original breeding unconfirmed)

mechanic.key_insight: Genome is immutable on-chain. Art is off-chain CDN. If Dapper disappears, genomes survive. Rendering requires reconstructing the art pipeline.

fossils.what_we_eat: The genetic mixing model. 256-bit genomes = bingo board voxels. Inheritance probabilities = Anderson localization in gene space. Mutation tiers = evolutionary pressure. Hidden recessives = latent value. Gene 31 (unreachable) = the null primal.

bingo_mapping.hidden_genes: latent dimensions — not expressed but inherited
bingo_mapping.gene_31: null voxel — exists in the space but unreachable by mutation

fossils.open_source: Contract bytecode public on Ethereum. Reverse-engineered by community (Kai's Genome Project). KittyCalc, CryptoKittydex, KittyHelper all open.

fossils.name: Axie Infinity
fossils.status: alive but pivoting (Ronin chain, 'Axie Core' announced)

mechanic.breeding: proof of play — earn the right to breed through battling
mechanic.core_vision: on-chain genetic code permanently alterable through on-chain actions

rust_repos.what: Spine runtime for Rust — skeletal animation

fossils.what_we_eat: Proof of play (not proof of stake/work). Breed through action, not money. The emotional bond model (pets, not tokens). Rust repos we can learn from. 64 public repos.
fossils.open_source: 64 public repos. Smart contracts on Etherscan. Gene parser open source (agp-npm).

fossils.name: Zed Run

mechanic.failure_mode: breeding = oversupply = asset inflation = value collapse

fossils.what_we_eat: The FAILURE MODE. Breeding without constraint = inflation. Our model (bingoCube) has dimensional bounds — you can't breed past the edges of the board. The voxel space is finite. Gene 31 is unreachable. The constraint IS the value.
fossils.lesson: Generative economies need thermodynamic limits. Entropy must be bounded.

fossils.name: Loopring L2
fossils.what_we_eat: The composability lesson. Application-specific rollups die. General-purpose organisms survive. We are organism, not application.
fossils.scatter_from: Loopring's cairn ? scatter to zkSync Era, Scroll, Polygon zkEVM. The winners absorbed its lesson.

fossils.name: SPAWN

mechanic.type: every swap spawns a child token ? branching tree
mechanic.what: Uniswap v4 hook: buy = spawn new child. Children can spawn children. Creator fee rises with generation.

fossils.what_we_eat: The branching tree model. Every interaction creates something new. Art-as-mechanism. The mechanism IS the message. This is sourdough — the starter culture spawns with every feed.

fossils.name: YAM

mechanic.failure_mode: rebase bug killed it. No testing. No audit.

fossils.what_we_eat: The elastic supply concept (supply adjusts to demand). The on-chain governance model. The lesson: test everything. We have 5,707+ validation checks. YAM had zero.

fossils.name: Ore
fossils.what_we_eat: Proof of work on a modern chain. The concept that mining can be computation, not just hash puzzles. Our GPU shaders ARE the proof of work — they produce science, not hashes.
fossils.lesson: Success can kill you if the infrastructure can't handle it.

fossils.name: Based Froggies

mechanic.type: fully on-chain genetics, breeding, mutations, ascensions

fossils.what_we_eat: Proof that on-chain genetics is ALIVE on Base (our target L2). When we get seed ? Base ? our cairns sit next to living genetic experiments.

scatter_pattern.description: Each fossil is a cairn. We eat the mechanic. We scatter from the cairn to find more forgotten projects with real mechanics.
chain: Loopring (zkRollup) ? scatter to ? zkSync Era, Scroll, Polygon zkEVM (alive)
CryptoKitties (genetics) ? scatter to ? Axie (spine-rs, Rust!), Based Froggies (Base, alive)
Zed Run (breeding failure) ? scatter to ? understand thermodynamic limits on generation

bingo_board_model.concept: CryptoKitties proved that a 256-bit genome is a dimensional space, not a currency. Each gene position is a voxel axis. Breeding is a voxel operation. This is bingoCube, not DeFi.

mapping.cryptokitties_genome: 48 genes × 5 bits = 240 active bits. Each gene = one axis of variation.
mapping.bingocube_voxel: N-dimensional space where each dimension has discrete states. Operations traverse the space.
mapping.breeding_as_voxel_op: parent_A(x1,y1,z1...) + parent_B(x2,y2,z2...) ? child(x3,y3,z3...) with probabilistic inheritance
mapping.hidden_genes_as_latent_dims: Unexpressed dimensions that influence offspring. Latent value.
mapping.mutation_as_dim_shift: Adjacent genes combine ? new gene in higher tier. Dimension expansion.
mapping.gene_31_as_null: Exists in the space but unreachable by mutation. The null primal. The Klein face.
